lessons.title: Bits, Bytes & Hex 🧮
lessons.description: Learn how computers represent data at the lowest level and why every forensic investigator must speak hex.

lessons.title: Endianness & Binary Structures 🏗️
lessons.description: Discover big‑endian vs little‑endian and why byte order can make or break your evidence interpretation.

lessons.title: Storage Anatomy: Sectors to Partitions 💾
lessons.description: Understand how hard drives and SSDs organize data physically and logically, from platters to partition tables.

lessons.title: File Systems: The Organisers 🗂️
lessons.description: Explore FAT, NTFS, ext4 and how they track files, directories, and deleted data.

lessons.title: Metadata & File Signatures 🕵️
lessons.description: Master MAC times and magic bytes – the hidden clues that reveal when and what a file really is.

lessons.title: Slack Space & Unallocated Realms 👻
lessons.description: Enter the twilight zones where deleted data hides: file slack, unallocated space, and carving gold.
